title: Minor oversubscribed and seat counter corrupted under simultaneous allocation decisions
root_cause: Capacity check, 'already in a minor' check and seats_filled += 1 were read-then-write with no lock; ORM increment wrote an absolute value (lost update)
reproduction: 10 SUBMITTED applications, 3 free seats; coordinator POSTs /minors/applications/{id}/decide ALLOCATED for all 10 at once (reports/qa/tools/race_minor_seats.py)
evidence: Before: 6/6 trials FAIL — 11 active enrolments vs capacity 4; seats_filled=2 (9 lost updates) — evidence/race6_minor_seats_trials.txt. After: 6/6 PASS — exactly 3 granted, 7 clean 409, counter exact — evidence/race6_minor_seats_after_fix.txt
fix: Row lock (SELECT … FOR UPDATE OF) on the minor programme and the student before the checks (app/db/locking.py; api/v1/minors.py decide; services/minors.allocate)
regression_test: app/tests/test_pg_concurrency.py::test_a_minor_never_takes_more_students_than_its_seats (PostgreSQL; verified to FAIL with the lock removed)

title: Event confirms more registrations than its capacity
root_cause: Count-then-insert with no lock
reproduction: Clear an event, capacity 5; 40 students POST /events/{id}/register at once (tools/race_event_trials.sh)
evidence: Before: 9/10 trials oversubscribed by 2–4 seats (evidence/race1_event_capacity_trials.txt). After: 10/10 exactly 5 confirmed, rest waitlisted (evidence/race1_event_capacity_after_fix.txt)
fix: Lock the event row before counting (events.register and cancel_registration waitlist promotion)
regression_test: app/tests/test_pg_concurrency.py::test_an_event_never_confirms_more_students_than_its_places (verified to FAIL with the lock removed)

title: Mentor cap (10 per mentor) exceeded by simultaneous assignments
root_cause: Count-then-update in override_mentor with no lock
reproduction: Coordinator POSTs /internships/enrollments/{id}/mentor for 15 students to one mentor at once (tools/race_mentor_cap.py)
evidence: Before: 8/8 trials — mentor ended with 13–15 students (evidence/race2_mentor_cap_trials.txt). After: 6/6 exactly 10 + 5 clean 409 (evidence/race2_mentor_cap_after_fix.txt)
fix: Lock the mentor's faculty row before counting (services/internships.override_mentor)
regression_test: Reproduction script only (tools/race_mentor_cap.py) — no pytest yet

title: Simultaneous preference submissions occasionally answered 500 although the write succeeded
root_cause: Response rows re-read after commit while a concurrent submission was replacing them
reproduction: 4 simultaneous POST /electives/preferences from one student, 30 trials (tools/race_preferences.py)
evidence: Before: 2/30 trials returned a 500 (data stayed correct) — evidence/race4_preferences_30.json. After: 30/30, all 120 requests 200 — evidence/race4_preferences_after_fix.json
fix: Serialise on the student row; build the response before commit

fix: Unknown emails are checked against a dummy bcrypt hash

title: A burst of sign-ins starves the portal; slow recovery
root_cause: bcrypt (~0.25 s CPU) ran unbounded inside the shared 40-thread pool while holding a DB connection; single uvicorn process; no request timeout
reproduction: Spike: 20 steady users + 200 users arriving in 5 s (tools/loadtest.py)
evidence: Before: spike users 90% failed; steady users 14% failed; 153 s to recover. After: 28%, 7.7%, 88 s (evidence/load/spike-*.json, spike_recovery*.txt)
fix: Release the DB connection before hashing; sign-ins queue in the event loop (≤ cores/2 at once) with a 503 after 15 s
status: Mitigated — capacity limit of one process remains (infrastructure decision)
